notes.claim: One radian is the measure of a central angle of a circle that intercepts an arc equal in length to the radius of that circle.
Degree and radian measure are related by 360 degrees = 2 pi radians, or 180 degrees = pi radians.
The arc length produced by a given angle has a constant relation to the radius, whatever the length of the radius.
